title: This Moth Has No Mouth and Only a Week to Live

scenes.text: This moth is born without a mouth. It has one week to live.
The luna moth eats as a caterpillar. As an adult, it has no mouth and no gut.
Its job is simple: mate, lay eggs, and die. Adults live about seven days.
But a week is long enough to be hunted. Bats use sound to find moths in the dark.
So the luna moth spins its long tails as it flies, and that confuses the bat's sonar.
In tests, bats struck those tails 55 percent of the time instead of the body.

description:
An adult luna moth has no mouth and no gut, so it lives only about a week.
Its long, spinning tails confuse bat sonar. In tests, bats struck the tails 55 percent of the time.
Would you rather have a week of wings or a lifetime of walking?
first_comment: Would you take one perfect week as a luna moth? Why or why not?
